subject.title: Add a reference GitHub integration for one managed channel per pull request

question: Should ClickClack publish and support a separately deployable reference GitHub App package after provider-scoped reconciliation lands, or keep GitHub PR coordination entirely as an external community integration?
rationale: The requested adapter adds a supported integration and operational/security boundary rather than repairing a documented broken behavior; current code provides primitives but no approved packaging or support commitment.

options.title: Sponsor an external reference package
options.body: Adopt a separately deployable GitHub App example after the reconciliation API is finalized, while keeping credentials and webhook runtime out of the ClickClack server.

options.title: Keep the boundary community-owned
options.body: Document the managed-channel API and let third parties publish GitHub adapters without an official reference implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor an external reference package
recommendation.body: Adopt a separately deployable GitHub App example after the reconciliation API is finalized, while keeping credentials and webhook runtime out of the ClickClack server.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the managed-channel product boundary that determines whether an official reference adapter belongs alongside the core API.
